title: One-sided annular bound δ·μ(B̄_ρ) ≤ 3·L(F ∩ (B_{ρ+δ} ∖ B̄_ρ)) from Gauss–Green and the normal-average lower bound (parent steps 2–5)
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ and D, F ⊆ ℝ^P (Euclid P) with F measurable. Let μ be a measure on ℝ^P, ν : ℝ^P → ℝ^P measurable with |ν(z)| ≤ 1 for all z, and y, v ∈ ℝ^P with |v| ≤ 1. Let ρ₂ ∈ ℝ with B̄_{ρ₂}(y) ⊆ D and μ(B̄_{ρ₂}(y)) < ∞. Assume two hypotheses. (GG): ∫_F div φ dL^P = −∫⟨φ, ν⟩ dμ for every C¹ map φ : ℝ^P → ℝ^P with compact support and tsupport φ ⊆ D, where div φ = trace Dφ and L^P = volume. (1′): ½ μ(B̄_r(y))_ℝ ≤ ∫_{B̄_r(y)} ⟨ν, v⟩ dμ for every r with 0 < r < ρ₂ (μ(·)_ℝ = ENNReal.toReal). Then for all ρ, δ > 0 with ρ + δ < ρ₂, δ·μ(B̄_ρ(y)) ≤ 3·L^P(F ∩ (B_{ρ+δ}(y) ∖ B̄_ρ(y))) in [0, ∞], i.e. ENNReal.ofReal δ * μ(B̄_ρ(y)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal 3 * volume(F ∩ (B_{ρ+δ}(y) ∖ B̄_ρ(y))).
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (D F : Set (Euclid P)) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (ν : Euclid P → Euclid P) (y v : Euclid P) (ρ₂ : ℝ), MeasurableSet F → closedBall y ρ₂ ⊆ D → μ (closedBall y ρ₂) ≠ ∞ → Measurable ν → (∀ z, ‖ν z‖ ≤ 1) → ‖v‖ ≤ 1 → (∀ φ : Euclid P → Euclid P, ContDiff ℝ 1 φ → HasCompactSupport φ → tsupport φ ⊆ D → ∫ z in F, LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid P) (fderiv ℝ φ z : Euclid P →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid P) = -∫ z, inner ℝ (φ z) (ν z) ∂μ) → (∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → r < ρ₂ → (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (μ (closedBall y r)).toReal ≤ ∫ z in closedBall y r, inner ℝ (ν z) v ∂μ) → ∀ ρ δ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → 0 < δ → ρ + δ < ρ₂ → ENNReal.ofReal δ * μ (closedBall y ρ) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal 3 * volume (F ∩ (ball y (ρ + δ) \ closedBall y ρ))
